randomness: NumPy PCG64. Policy uses seed directly. Environment uses SeedSequence([seed,871]), allocating two uniforms per scheduled tick for position and mode. Conditional on old x,m and applied u, draw both successors independently with categorical inverse CDF. Reveal only x_next*2+m_next.
warmup_policy: Use the last publicly observed product sensor x*2+m (reset 0). Select right/2 if m==1 or x==0, else left/0. This visits the measured column whenever its public context holds and otherwise aims to return to position 0.

arms_explanation.stationary: Same P-substitution, original stationary accumulating Dirichlet
arms_explanation.no_epistemics: Same changing transition posterior, ordinary BP transition in the planner, observation P-substitution retained. This removes the whole transition P-substitution and uses its expected-log parameter.

model: All start with a uniform position law and unit reset concentration per outcome of every (mode,action,source) column. Mode law is fixed and known. Every observation identifies position and mode. World old/new transition laws and switch time are withheld from agents.
estimands: Per-seed averages, equal seed weights. First 16 post preaction ticks versus last 8 warm for changing-world target committed trace and forecast D1. All 48 post ticks for visitation and goal occupancy. Exact evaluator-only KL(true target column || next-event forecast) over first 24 for prediction; all 48 and mean over unchanged position columns separately. Recovery is first start of 3 consecutive post ticks with target KL<=.1. No imputation for invalid/incomplete grid.
compute: Seconds elapsed in full native act, observe, and actual Learnables.accumulate nested within observe. Sample whole-process resident bytes at both boundaries and every 5ms during act/update. Native graph reuse only within a freshly started cell process. RSS is sampled absolute memory; no allocation attribution.
parity: No optimized estimator or solver. All trials use public RollingAgent.act/observe. Against an optimized path the mandatory bounds would be 128*float64 epsilon on messages, 256*epsilon on node objectives and identical stable-index policy ranking; none is being compared.
dev_gate: All twelve dev arm-world cells complete saturation plus 3 policy actions, filter/plan converge with finite energies and required planning root, model archives roundtrip and pairings agree up to switch and first post action. Failure is preserved and blocks held-out scoring on this protocol.
revision_policy: Freeze a protocol, model artifacts and code digest before scored reads. Any change affecting a cell invalidates that cell for comparison and requires a new version and output directory.
prior_version: Version 1 used alternating actions, development seed 19501 and the same thresholds. Four of six cells failed the saturation diagnostic and no scored cell was opened. Version 2 changes only the shared acquisition policy, disjoint development seeds and qualification bookkeeping.
